meta.name: opencode-qa
meta.description: QA opencode itself, per case: verify the CLI/terminal (opencode run, db, serve, export), prove a specific plugin hook/action/event fired via the SSE event stream, smoke-test the TUI under tmux, and investigate sessions in opencode's SQLite DB by id, title/name, or message text. Ships tested helper scripts (each with a --self-test) plus per-domain references. Use whenever someone wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug opencode's CLI, HTTP server, plugin hooks/events, or TUI, or to find/inspect opencode sessions in the database. Triggers: opencode qa, qa opencode, test opencode, verify opencode hook, opencode session db, find opencode session by id/name/text, opencode tui test, opencode server health, opencode event stream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证 AI 编程助手的命令、界面与数据记录是否正常
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要验证 opencode 的命令、插件触发及会话数据是否正常
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on or use an AI coding assistant and need to verify its CLI, plugin events, or session history

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 opencode 的 QA 请求映射到测试脚本:验证 CLI 命令、按 ID/标题/文本在 SQLite 中查找会话、经 SSE 事件流确认钩子、在 tmux 下冒烟测试 TUI。每个脚本都支持 --self-test 自检。
howto.when: 当你想验证、冒烟测试或调试 opencode(如“opencode qa”“verify opencode hook”等),或想按 ID、标题、文本查找其数据库会话时触发。

say.text: 验证 opencode 的插件钩子是否触发。
say.note: 监听 SSE 事件流中的 server.connected。

say.text: 找一下最近提到‘permission denied’的会话。
say.note: 按消息文本搜索,限定最近范围。

say.text: 冒烟测试 opencode 的 TUI。
say.note: 在 tmux 隔离环境启动,检查渲染。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude maps opencode QA requests to bundled scripts: verifies CLI commands, finds sessions in SQLite by ID/title/text, confirms hooks via SSE stream, and smoke-tests the TUI under tmux. Each script supports --self-test.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to verify, smoke-test, or debug opencode (e.g. 'opencode qa', 'verify opencode hook'), or find sessions in its database by ID, title, or text.

say_en.text: Check if opencode's plugin hook fires.
say_en.note: Listens for server.connected on the SSE stream.
Searches by message text, scoped to recent sessions.
Launches in an isolated tmux and checks rendering.
